summary: Prepare and publish a focused change for review through the available review adapter.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: Exact candidate revision, changed behavior, and implementation scope.

inputs.name: verification-report
inputs.description: Checks and evidence bound to the exact candidate and inputs.

inputs.name: review-report
inputs.description: Reviewed candidate, findings, dispositions, and unresolved risks.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Behavior, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, and exclusions.

inputs.name: impact-assessment
inputs.description: Affected consumers, boundaries, operational risks, and verification needs.

completion_checks: The published or prepared candidate matches the verified and reviewed revision.
The review package explains the problem, resulting behavior, evidence, and remaining limits.
failure_modes: Missing required inputs, capability, or authority: blocked; retain a concrete next action.
Contradictory or insufficient evidence: inconclusive; never report an unobserved outcome as passed.
A demonstrated violation of a required condition: failed; preserve reproducible evidence.
